title: Règne Delta is out tomorrow (Fri 6 Nov); online game gets it today
detail: Worldwide release 6 Nov, Pokémon TCG Live from 5 Nov (one fan-site report). Headliner is Mega Rayquaza ex, with a new Legendary Stadium card type. A Pocket expansion also lands on 6 Nov. No delay reported. Exact card count differs between sources, so unconfirmed.

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): only the 6-booster bundle is still in stock
detail: Today the shop page shows the Bundle 6 boosters €44.99 (2nd wave, arrives 17 Nov) available. Display 36 (€239.99), Elite Trainer Box (€79.99), 3-pack blister (€19.99) and single booster (€7.99) are all marked sold out. The page's own filter counts disagree with the product labels, so check with the shop.

title: Mega Darkrai ex SIR (Pitch Black) steady
detail: Cardmarket 7-day average €180.02 vs 30-day €184.05 (updated 4 Nov); the short-term trend price is lower at €168.65. No 20% move, no alert. Other cards not checked: the collection file has no card IDs.

title: OP-18: nothing new; Japan date still 21 or 22 Nov (unconfirmed)
detail: Card reveals continue on Bandai's X account, no November news found. English name and date not announced.

title: Regionals Porto and Sydney are this Saturday, 7 Nov
detail: Still upcoming, no results yet. No Pokémon event finished since yesterday.
